identity.title: Giratina and the Sky Warrior (graphic novel)

leadText: Giratina and the Sky Warrior is a graphic novel published by VIZ Media in North America and Shogakukan in Japan. It is a manga-style book (branded as "Ani-Manga" by VIZ) which retells the plot of Giratina and the Sky Warrior using screenshots from the film. Hideki Sonoda is credited as the author.
plainText:
Giratina and the Sky Warrior is a graphic novel published by VIZ Media in North America and Shogakukan in Japan. It is a manga-style book (branded as "Ani-Manga" by VIZ) which retells the plot of Giratina and the Sky Warrior using screenshots from the film. Hideki Sonoda is credited as the author.

==Publications==
 
 
 
 
 

==Plot==
The contents of this book are adapted from the film of the same name.

===Chapters===
Prologue
Chapter 1: Into the Reverse World
Chapter 2: Shaymin's Voyage
Chapter 3: Battle Against Giratina
Chapter 4: Zero's True Ambitions
Chapter 5: The Oncoming Glacier
Epilogue

== Characters ==

Zero
Newton Graceland
Infi

Moose

== Trivia ==
In the graphic novel, there are no moments from the credits that were in the movie of the same name.
=== Errors ===
Gracidea is incorrectly spelled as "Glacidea" twice near the end of the novel, while at the beginning, it is spelled correctly.
